items.markdown:
UK ordinary passport holders can visit Thailand for tourism without a pre-arranged visa , enjoying a visa-exempt stay of up to 60 days, though `travelers needing a formal Tourist Visa (TR) can apply online`.[](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/do-you-need-a-visa-for-thailand-tourist-visa-rules-explained.html) [[1]](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/do-you-need-a-visa-for-thailand-tourist-visa-rules-explained.html)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa)[[3]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)

Entry Requirements and Exemption

- **Passport Validity:** Must be valid for at least 6 months with one blank page.
- **Onward Travel:** Confirmed return or onward ticket leaving Thailand within the allowed period.
- **Financial Proof:** Evidence of sufficient funds for your stay.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa) 

Applying via the E-Visa Portal

- **Application:** Submit digital copies through the [Thai E-Visa Official Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/).
- **Documents:** Upload a passport photo, flight confirmation, and accommodation booking.
- **Processing:** Usually takes 2 to 10 business days.[](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) [[1]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)[[2]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)

If you'd like, let me know:

- Your **exact nationality** if different from a UK passport holder
- Your **intended length of stay** in Thailand

I can check if you qualify for visa exemption or need a formal visa application.
